stepTitle: Aneesh has a broken copy of the jacket, called jacket\_miss. This broken copy has some missing values in num\_jacket\_bought. No other columns have missing values.\n\nAneesh wants to produce a contour plot that visualizes the joint distribution of collar\_size and num\_jacket\_bought from jacket\_miss. Fill all missing values with $$0$$. Do not include any datapoint where the value of num\_jacket\_bought is higher than $$10$$. Fill in the blanks to achieve this.
